grammar.summary: 本课探讨猫的特性与生存本领，运用 never fail to do 双重否定表肯定、the+比较级...the+比较级（越……越……）结构，以及 that 引导同位语从句解释「猫有九命」的信念，并出现 so far 与现在完成时连用。

points.title: 双重否定表肯定 (Double Negative for Affirmation)
points.explanation: never fail to do = always manage to do，否定词 never 与 fail 搭配构成双重否定，强调「总是能、从不做不到」，语气比直接肯定更强。本课用 Cats never fail to fascinate human beings 强调「猫总能引起人们的极大兴趣」。

examples.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
examples.cn: 猫总能引起人们的极大兴趣。

points.title: the+比较级...the+比较级 (The more...the more...)
points.explanation: the + 比较级 + 主谓，the + 比较级 + 主谓，表示「越……就越……」，两个比较级结构对称。本课用 the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves 说明「猫跌落得越高，越不容易受伤」。

examples.en: It seems that the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves.
examples.cn: 看起来，猫跌落的距离越长，它们就越不会伤害自己。

points.title: 同位语从句 (Appositive Clause with that)
points.explanation: that 引导同位语从句，解释说明抽象名词（belief, idea, fact 等）的具体内容，that 不作句子成分、只起连接作用。本课用 the popular belief that they have nine lives 解释「猫有九条命」这一信念的内容。

examples.en: One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief that they have nine lives.
examples.cn: 最使我们感兴趣的一件事情就是一种通俗的信念——猫有九条命。

exercises.q: Cats ______ fail to fascinate human beings.（填入使句意为肯定「总能」的词）
It seems that ______ cats fall, ______ they are likely to injure themselves.
One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief ______ they have nine lives.
填入与 fail 搭配表肯定「总能」的副词：Cats ______ fail to fascinate human beings.
